#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR"
python3 scaffolds/launch/frozen.py check --launch-commit 2f11d5a3df81e8b0ca7624977d12a92d42e01833 --experiment hermite_attention --scaffold transformer
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD" JAX_PLATFORMS=cuda OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false
PYTHON="$PWD/scaffolds/transformer/.venv/bin/python"
export CUDA_HOME="$("$PYTHON" -c 'import importlib.util; print(next(iter(importlib.util.find_spec("nvidia.cuda_nvcc").submodule_search_locations)))')"
source scaffolds/transformer/launchers/kennel_runtime.sh
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv
"$PYTHON" - <<'META'
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,socket
import jax
from datetime import datetime,UTC
from scaffolds.launch.frozen import frozen_hash
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
metadata={"source_commit":"2f11d5a3df81e8b0ca7624977d12a92d42e01833","home_cluster":"kennel","artifact_root":str(root),"node":socket.gethostname(),"slurm_job_id":os.environ["SLURM_JOB_ID"],"partition":os.environ["SLURM_JOB_PARTITION"],"gpu_count":len(jax.devices()),"devices":[str(x) for x in jax.devices()],"gpu_type":jax.devices()[0].device_kind,"runtime":{k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ["CUDA_HOME","JAX_PLATFORMS","TRANSFORMER_HOST_STAGING","NCCL_P2P_DISABLE","XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE"]},"frozen_execution_set_sha256":frozen_hash(root,"2f11d5a3df81e8b0ca7624977d12a92d42e01833","hermite_attention","transformer"),"lock_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"scaffolds/transformer/uv.lock").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"started_utc":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),"resolved_attention_backend":"fused","data":"Seeded synthetic arrays; no external dataset","selected_checkpoints":[]}
(root/"scaffolds/transformer/validation/runs/fixed-polynomial-h100/metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(metadata))
META
"$PYTHON" -m pytest -c scaffolds/transformer/pyproject.toml --import-mode=importlib -q scaffolds/transformer/tests/test_fixed_polynomial_fused.py --junitxml=scaffolds/transformer/validation/logs/fixed-polynomial-h100/pytest.xml
